name: direct-contour-absolute-fourier-train-only-calibration
status: Frozen before one CPU-only true-contour representation calibration; no learner fit, base-model prediction, score-tail read, GPU fit or public submission
user_evaluation_rule: All original salt-0 tail 70 shots and 14,830 frames remain evaluation-only for every future fitted base or correction model. The prior 35/35 diagnostic remains a historical screen and is superseded for future protocols.
question: Can a low-dimensional absolute physical LCFS representation retain scorer-native true DIII-D boundaries accurately enough to justify an input-only learner trained on the remaining 6,971 shots?

sample.eligibility: Inspect only the compact artifact's TRAIN filenames in their saved order. A shot is eligible if its permitted efit_times has at least three finite, strictly increasing frames. Select the first 100 eligible shots, without looking at psi or any derived target; inspect at most the first 200 filenames and abort if fewer than 100 qualify.
sample.index_formula: For n frames and each fixed quantile q, select floor(q*(n-1)+0.5). Require the three indices to be distinct; if a metadata-eligible shot violates this, fail rather than substitute another shot.
sample.freeze_before_truth_read: Publish the complete ordered 100 basenames, each full frame count and three indices, input parquet/source hashes, scorer hashes and source snapshot into an ignored immutable run directory before opening efit_psirz. The tail70 filenames cannot appear in the sample.

truth_and_representation.truth: Use the frozen scorer's LCFS extraction from true efit_psirz on only the selected 100 TRAIN shots and three fixed frames per shot, with the DIII-D envelope mask and physical efit_grid_R/Z. Never use the stored efit_lcfs_* contour or a scored-tail label. Missing/non-simple true contour is a recorded feasibility failure, not a skipped frame.
truth_and_representation.canonicalization: Orient the 512-point arclength-sampled physical (R,Z) polygon counterclockwise using signed area; then cyclically roll the first point to maximum R with lowest-index tie. Reject nonfinite, zero-area or self-crossing polygons.
truth_and_representation.encoding: For each coordinate independently, keep the real DC and complex Fourier modes 1..K of the canonical 512-point contour, set higher modes to zero, inverse-transform to a physical polygon; K8 has 34 real coefficients, K16 has 66. No contour truth enters input features or a public prediction.
truth_and_representation.measurements: For each K, report pooled centered-shape energy retained (subtract the per-frame contour centroid before the Fourier energy), median/p95/max scorer-native symmetric physical Hausdorff distance from reconstructed polygon to C_true, simple-polygon fraction, within-grid fraction and per-frame invalid reasons. Preserve exact shot/frame order and all 300 rows in ignored run evidence; track a small summary JSON.
truth_and_representation.selection_gate: Choose the smallest K whose reconstruction has zero non-simple/out-of-grid frames, median Hausdorff <= 0.25 minimum physical grid cell and p95 Hausdorff <= 0.5 cell on these TRAIN-ONLY probes. If neither K passes, stop this absolute-Fourier family before full target extraction or fit. No K choice uses validation1338 or evaluation70 outcomes.
truth_and_representation.interpretation: This is geometric representation feasibility only, not a score gain, learner fit, public-fold bound or proof that the coefficients are predictable from permitted inputs.

cost_and_next_gate.anticipated_cpu_time: Two to five minutes for 100 selected parquets/300 scorer LCFS extractions plus complete pinned-manifest validation; measure actual stages. No GPU or full corpus target cache.
cost_and_next_gate.if_representation_passes: Propose, then root-review/freeze an exact direct contour learner on compact train5633/validation1338 with all tail70 reserved only for its final native evaluation. Inputs must be permitted 208 baseline features plus shot phase (width209), with no base-model map, contour or residual target in learner fit. No full extraction/model fit/public run follows automatically from this calibration.
